blocks.text: Tidecomb gathers a shell and a comb into one ordinary word. The object suggests a remnant returned by water; its use does not restore a complete ancient identity or recover a person from an archive.
An asymmetrical dark plum sea-glass shell containing nested gold comb teeth and a pale aqua seed.
One-shot use: The shell hinges fully apart and the comb swings out, releasing a broad aqua wash. The game performs the final fade.
52 silver. Clears Infection / Parasites. No recovery-timer change or Potion Boost.
Original PixelLab artwork and reviewed use animation, October 28, 2026. Image d657cfa7-32d2-4774-b63a-3b3d022751a0; animation 54a10316-afbe-49c2-99f0-7564bc814272. Reduced motion holds a still.
